free_tier.stated: none: Artifact Registry has no free tier; the free tier covers Object Storage, Container Apps and Managed BI only

egress.terms: Egress is billed from 100 GB per month at 1.39995 RUB/GB (VAT incl., 22%); the first 100 GB per month is not billed

interface_detail: oci for Docker images and Helm charts; rest management API at https://ar.api.cloud.ru; Deb, RPM, PyPI, NPM and generic registries use their own package-manager protocols (no vocabulary term)
tooling: Docker/OCI registry at <registry_name>.cr.cloud.ru, ORAS-compatible; supports Docker, Helm, Deb, RPM, PyPI, NPM and generic artifacts; 10 registries per org
chaining: quotas are per organisation and raisable via support ticket, so the multiplication axis is organisations, not registries: 10 registries share one 500 GB pool

limits.value: 500 GB of stored space per organisation (initial quota, raisable via technical support)
1 TB of egress per month per organisation (quota)

limits_note: 500 GB / 1 TB egress per org by default; storage 0.00268071 RUB/GB-hour (~1.96 RUB/GB/mo); Docker image deletion can take up to 24 h and keeps billing until complete
reliability_note: Fully metered — 500 GB is a cap, not an allowance; no free tier is documented for this service, so it costs money from the first GB.
confidence_note: the verdict rests on vendor pages read on 2026-11-03: the free tier page lists the services with a free tier (Artifact Registry is not among them), the limitations page quotes the initial stored-space quota, the pricing page quotes the unbilled first part of monthly egress, and the tariff PDF quotes the egress and storage rates
